explanation.en: have/has + the third form of the verb. The third form is not always the same as the past.
explanation.uz: have/has + fe'lning UCHINCHI shakli. Uchinchi shakl har doim ham o'tgan zamon shakli bilan bir xil emas: go/went/gone.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida bu zamonning aniq ekvivalenti yo'q — shuning uchun A1/A2 ning eng qiyin qismi.

grammar.label: present perfect — experience (ever / never)
grammar.form: Have you ever…? / I have never…
grammar.meaning: at some indefinite time in your life

explanation.en: Use it for things that happened at some time in your life. The exact time is not given.
explanation.uz: Hayotingizda qachondir bo'lgan ish uchun. Aniq vaqt AYTILMAYDI.

grammar.negative_example: I have never been to Japan last year.
